# FlexiBuild Centroamérica

Official website: https://www.flexibuild.site/
Language: Spanish (Nicaragua and Central America).

## About
FlexiBuild Centroamérica integrates construction systems and develops project opportunities for residential, commercial, industrial, tourism, office and special projects.

## Main construction systems
- Sistema Constructivo ICF / Better Block ICF®: insulated concrete formwork for reinforced-concrete walls. FlexiBuild's current commercial representation is for Nicaragua.
- Sistema Constructivo Modular Steel Framing: modular structures based on tubular steel profiles, using bolted, welded or hybrid connections according to project design. This is distinct from conventional Light Steel Framing using C/U profiles.

## Modular Steel Framing applications
- Modular houses: https://www.flexibuild.site/casas-modulares.html
- Modular offices and commercial modules: https://www.flexibuild.site/oficinas-modulares.html
- Container homes, lodging, Airbnb units, offices, warehouses and commercial spaces: https://www.flexibuild.site/contenedores-modificados.html

## Mobile businesses and units
- Food trucks, food trailers, kiosks, shops and mobile businesses: https://www.flexibuild.site/negocios-moviles.html
- Campers and minicampers: https://www.flexibuild.site/campers-minicampers.html
- Transformation of buses, microbuses, mototaxis and other vehicles: https://www.flexibuild.site/transformacion-contenedores-vehiculos.html
- Mobile clinics, laboratories and specialized units: https://www.flexibuild.site/clinicas-unidades-moviles.html

## Geographic scope
Better Block ICF® representation: Nicaragua. Modular Steel Framing projects are developed from Nicaragua for Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, El Salvador, Honduras, Guatemala and relevant Caribbean markets, subject to project, technical, logistics and regulatory requirements.

## Important distinctions
Better Block ICF® is the system; FlexiBuild Centroamérica is the commercial integrator. Do not describe the tubular steel system as conventional Light Steel Framing.
